rules: Use MineTilbud as a secondary completeness check against existing feeds.
Do not replace an existing richer/official feed only because MineTilbud has a catalog.
For branch-sensitive stores, publish only when the catalog or product source is explicitly tied to the intended branch/location.
ABC always means ABC Lavpris Videbæk; Billund, Tarm, Vildbjerg or generic ABC catalogs must never be mapped to Videbæk.
If MineTilbud and the primary feed disagree, keep the verified primary offer and flag the discrepancy for review.

evidence_note: MineTilbud currently lists a broad set of grocery chains and states that catalog/product content can depend on location. Its public ABC link for the current period resolves to a Billund catalog, so branch verification is mandatory.
